Bringing expensive 
medicines within 
reach
Empathy
We understand the 
needs of our patients 
and partners better than 
others
Dynamism
We solve challenges that 
only a few can, and do 
this with agility
Addressing unmet 
patient needs
Helping patients 
manage disease better
Working with 
partners to help 
them succeed
Enabling and helping our partners 
ensure that our medicines are available 
where needed
OUR
PRINCIPLES
OUR
PROMISES
We accelerate 
access to affordable 
and innovative 
medicines because
Good Health
Can’t Wait.
OUR PURPOSE
Who we are
Our credo
Aspirational 
growth mindset
People 
leadership
Result-driven
Speed and rigour 
in execution
Innovation
Excellence focus
We target industry-leading 
growth through innovation, cost 
leadership and taking risks
We inspire people to reach their 
full potential through work and 
continuous learning
We take responsibility for 
outcomes and own end results 
for our patients
We act with agility; We are 
disciplined and rigorous in 
execution
We drive patient and customer-
focused innovation in all areas 
using cutting-edge science, 
technology and tools
We excel by combining deep 
professional expertise and 
disciplined execution
Integrity and transparency
Uphold the highest standards of 
integrity and transparency in all 
our conversations
Safety
Remain committed to providing 
safe working environments 
through continuous improvements 
in our infrastructure, work 
practices and behaviours
Quality
Be dedicated to designing quality 
into our products and processes 
to meet the highest standards of 
safety and efficacy
Productivity
Strive to achieve more with less 
through a culture of innovation, 
continuous improvements and 
sustained focus on elimination 
of waste
Respect for the individual
Stay committed to creating a work 
environment that encourages 
diverse perspectives and upholds 
the dignity of work and individuals
Collaboration and teamwork
Leverage expertise and resources 
from across our global network 
to create greater value for our 
stakeholders
Sustainability
Create value for our stakeholders 
in a way that respects our natural 
environment and best serves the 
interests of the communities where 
we live and work
OUR
VALUES
OUR 
LEADERSHIP
BEHAVIOURS
